response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, s.instownpct AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT mix, AVG(own) AS mix_avg FROM units GROUP BY mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS overall_avg FROM units), kept AS (SELECT u.own, b.mix_avg, o.overall_avg FROM units u JOIN base b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE u.own > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_kept_ownership, AVG(own / mix_avg) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline, AVG(own - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM kept
